description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing cron job run logs, including reading, writing, pruning, and path resolution.

methods.name: assertSafeCronRunLogJobId
methods.description: Validates and trims a job ID to ensure it does not contain unsafe characters.

methods.name: resolveCronRunLogPath
methods.description: Resolves and validates the file path for a cron run log based on store path and job ID.

methods.name: resolveCronRunLogPruneOptions
methods.description: Determines pruning options (maxBytes and keepLines) from configuration, with defaults.

methods.name: getPendingCronRunLogWriteCountForTests
methods.description: Returns the current count of pending log writes for testing purposes.

methods.name: appendCronRunLog
methods.description: Appends a log entry to the specified cron run log file, managing concurrent writes and pruning.

methods.name: readCronRunLogEntries
methods.description: Reads and returns log entries from a file, with optional limit and job ID filtering.

methods.name: readCronRunLogEntriesPage
methods.description: Reads a page of log entries from a file, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: readCronRunLogEntriesPageAll
methods.description: Reads log entries from all log files in the store directory, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
